lessons.title: Analogy & classification
lessons.objective: Build competition-ready understanding of analogy & classification and apply it accurately to unfamiliar questions.
lessons.core_teaching_content: Reasoning questions reward a repeatable method: identify the relationship, represent the information, test the rule, and eliminate contradictions. For series, inspect differences or transformations; for coding, compare symbol changes; for syllogisms, separate what must be true from what may be true. Focus on analogy & classification. Identify the defining concepts, common misconceptions, relevant evidence and a repeatable solving method. Practise moving from recognition to application: identify what the question tests, select the method, reason carefully, then verify the answer against the wording and constraints. Keep an error log describing the misconception rather than only recording the correct answer.
examples: A Reasoning Challenge question on analogy & classification should be solved by identifying the key clue, applying the relevant principle, and checking every stated condition.
Create a new analogy & classification scenario with one tempting distractor and explain why the correct response is better supported.
lessons.practical_activity: Complete a focused Reasoning Challenge activity on analogy & classification: build a small table, diagram, worked example or practice set, then explain the reasoning.
lessons.guided_practice: Work through three scaffolded tasks on analogy & classification: model the first, prompt the second, and require independent justification on the third.
independent_practice: Solve three unfamiliar questions on analogy & classification without viewing the answer.
Create one new example and solve it using the lesson method.
Review one distractor or error and explain why it is wrong.
lessons.assessment_checkpoint: Complete an eight-item Reasoning Challenge checkpoint focused on analogy & classification; target at least six correct and justify uncertain responses.
lessons.student_task: Produce one finished Reasoning Challenge task demonstrating analogy & classification and record the reasoning or evidence used.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Coach toward evidence-based reasoning and precise terminology. Ask for the method before giving correction; convert errors into reusable practice rules. Suitable for self-learning.
lessons.reflection_completion: Record one strength, one mistake pattern and one concrete action for improving analogy & classification.
lessons.daily_flow: Learn → Worked Example → Guided Practice → Independent Practice → Check → Reflect
